notes.title: She is coming even hornier! Check the news about Trix and the Horny Tower
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570005/d8ca83c7ef136c144ca107e5c2590221a6df3d81.png[/img]

I’m so excited to say that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1168850/Trix_and_the_Horny_Tower/]Trix and the Horny Tower[/url] has been receiving an amazing remake and A LOT of things are coming to make you have a fun and hornier experience.
 
Now, Trix has a Lust Bar that can allow her to use powerful skills as well as unlock hot moments in the H-scenes. During these moments, you’ll be able to choose Trix’s answers and if you have enough Lust Points, you’ll unlock the final moment. Check it out.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570005/0323b7ecce61f9706ced335756050f0469d57b46.png[/img]
 
Also, each Sector (set of 5 floors) has a unique mechanic and different types of challenges. For example, in Levels 1 and 2 from Sector 1, you’ll face a boulder puzzle. When you reach the third and fourth floor, a lever challenge. When you finally reach the last floor (5th), you’ll face both mechanics working together!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570005/1855b37809fcc436f8b04324275b9bd7a546d5a6.png[/img]
 
Last but not least, all girls were remade and Zoe, the alchemist, has joined the crew.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570005/937d2dc3ccdf2637c006935010d47f436505a027.png[/img]
